data.name: Swapnilraj
data.gender_notes: Swapnilraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Swapnil means new and Raj means king. The name Swapnilraj carries the meaning “New King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Swapnilraj usually hope their child will grow to embody new king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Swapnilraj signifies a leader who is always ready to start anew.
data.etymology: Swapnilraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “New King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Swapnilraj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference:
Swapnilraj was a notable Hindu king from the Satavahana Dynasty, reigning from approximately 170 AD to 210 AD.
Context: Swapnilraj is known for his architectural achievements, such as the construction of the Am Bevanapalli Temple in Amaravati.

Swapnilraj was a revered Hindu sage from the 13th century, often considered as one of the 68 Bhagavatas.
Context: Swapnilraj is believed to have contributed significantly to the development of the Bhagavata Purana, an important Hindu scripture.
